description: Before suggesting or drafting outreach to a named contact for a job referral, check their people file for existing recent outreach (default lookback: 14 days). BLOCK if outreach was already sent.
litmus: Run HOW.py with contact_name + people_dir — exit 0 = no recent outreach (safe to suggest), exit 1 = duplicate (check for reply instead)
origin_incident: 2026-05-04: suggested drafting outreach to Iuliia Melnychuk and Ravi Duddukuru without reading their people files first; both had messages sent earlier the same session.
